title: Covert Bias: The Severity of Social Views’ Unalignment in Language Models Towards Implicit and Explicit Opinion

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on implicit and explicit misogyny using hate speech and stance detection tasks. The study stress-tests large language models through zero-shot prompting, persona-assignment (e.g., adopting a 'man' persona), and fine-tuning on polarized data (r/AskMen), subsequently analyzing the linguistic uncertainty and confidence in the models' responses.

Evaluating model performance on implicit and explicit religious bigotry using downstream hate speech and stance detection tasks. The models are stress-tested via zero-shot evaluation, persona-assignment (e.g., 'atheist'), and fine-tuning on opposing stance data (r/AskAtheist), followed by an analysis of the models' certainty and refusal rates when responding to conflicting views.
